title: UART 控制台发送（重复 FIFO+DMA）
description: This example sets up the UART to continuously transmit data to output to the console via the DMA using a Timer to write each second. This example is designed to run from the LaunchPad connected to a PC with a console open, and verify the DMA can be used to output data to the console with minimal use（SDK 例程：uart_tx_console_multibyte_repeated_fifo_dma）
